name: awrtifact
description: Deliberately chunk artifacts into GitHub release assets — the productized aitherkvcache mirror lane.
adopt: Stand up a versioned artifact store repo and use it immediately — `awrtifact provision-repo --repo you/store` creates + seeds the repo (Pages gate included), `awrtifact mirror <URL|FILE> --release TAG` stores one artifact, `awrtifact fetch NAME --url U --out F` gets it back byte-verified.
